ITEM 1 | Large white square-ish plate, roughly 26 cm across, used as the scale reference; no food on this item | 0
ITEM 2 | Single piece of meat-like portion, reddish-brown to dark caramelized surface with pale fibrous interior edges, slightly glossy and moist, about 6 cm by 4 cm and about 2 cm thick, sitting at the left-center of the plate with a small pale shred on its top edge | 60
ITEM 3 | Bright green slender stalks, lightly wilted and glossy with a little oil, arranged in a loose cluster about 10 cm long, piled across the upper right area and extending down toward the center | 70
ITEM 4 | Dark brown to nearly black pieces with a crisp, slightly charred and glossy surface, irregular shapes about 4 cm across, sitting on the right side among the green stalks | 50
ITEM 5 | Tan-yellow round legumes, firm and matte, about 1 cm diameter each, scattered among wilted dark green leafy greens and thin green stems in a cluster about 8 cm by 7 cm at the lower right | 45
ITEM 6 | Wilted dark green leafy greens with thin pale stems, limp and slightly glossy, mixed under the legumes at the bottom right of the plate, about 6 cm across | 25
ITEM 7 | Small translucent pale shreds and bits of soft, light-colored material on the plate near the top edge of the meat piece, very thin and sparse | 3
